title: Decision: maxConcurrentRequests enforced per account
description: RFC 8620 §2 (rfc8620.txt L534-537): maxConcurrentRequests is 'the maximum number of concurrent requests the server will accept to the API endpoint'. Readings: server-wide (literal) vs per account. Chosen (Mark, 2026-10-19): per account; a server-wide cap lets one user block all others and advertises a shared number to each user. Over the cap: request error urn:ietf:params:jmap:error:limit with limit maxConcurrentRequests (L1100-1104). Value 4 (RFC suggested minimum).
